name: XCP-ng / XenServer / Xen Orchestra
description: Reads the pools of Vates VMS (XCP-ng with Xen Orchestra) and of XenServer: hosts, virtual machines with their addresses and the storage repositories. Talks to a Xen Orchestra, or straight to a pool master when there is none. Read-only, unless you let auto-remediation restart a VM.
author: Netlens
supports: XCP-ng 8.3 pool master over the XAPI (tested)
XenServer pool masters over the XAPI (same API; not tested)

releases.changelog: Talks to the device through Netlens' shared HTTP client (certificate and host name checks, timeouts, size limit and redirect rules are the same in every plugin). Needs Netlens 0.4.366 or newer. No change in what the plugin reads or writes.
First release. Needs Netlens 0.4.180 or newer (storage reported by a hypervisor plugin).
